amem:BELIEVED.slot: no slot field; tags share zero names with the FR ontology
amem:BELIEVED.sup_events: the 23,403 `links` references resolve to 0 note ids and are NEVER used to synthesise a supersession graph
amem:BELIEVED.superseded: no lifecycle field of any kind

mem0:BELIEVED.active: no active/inactive state; _update_memory rewrites the payload in place
mem0:BELIEVED.category: no category field in the payload
mem0:BELIEVED.retracted: _delete_memory hard-deletes, leaving no trace in the store
mem0:BELIEVED.slot: no slot field in the payload
mem0:BELIEVED.sup_events: updated_at points at nothing; no event record survives
mem0:BELIEVED.superseded: EXPRESSIBLE as a bare boolean only: presence of updated_at (1,276 / 10,074 points); the prior value is destroyed

settled_readings.R2: index text names neither backend, variant nor provenance; all three live in the key, so the ablation is not announced to the model
settled_readings.R3: recency from each store's own content date (backends.recency_time), not the ingest wall-clock
